releases.title: The Isolate Thief
releases.synopsis: One bitter-cold winter during the Civil War, a young woman becomes the lone caretaker of a remote Union Army outpost. When a stash of stolen gold falls into her lap, a gang of vicious outlaws comes looking for it. As they turn her home into a battleground, she must stay one step ahead of them in order to survive.

releases.title: April X
releases.synopsis: When his twin sister April goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. As Bax gets pulled deep into a violent criminal underworld, he is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

releases.title: Bad Apples
releases.synopsis: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

releases.title: Beware Boiuna
releases.synopsis: A team of young doctors on a humanitarian mission through the Amazon rainforest come to realize that not everyone – or everything – is happy to see them. Their arrival draws the attention of an ancient predator, the “Boiúna”, This ancient killer, dominant on land and water, emerges to reclaim the jungle. The ensuing fight for survival blurs the roles of hunter, prey, and hero.

releases.title: Charlie Harper
releases.synopsis: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

releases.title: Daniel And The Fiery Furnace
releases.synopsis: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon’s armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

releases.title: The History Of Concrete
releases.synopsis: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

releases.title: Model Citizen
releases.synopsis: Former police officer Steven Bay is haunted by amnesia and fragments of a life he can no longer remember. When seeking treatment, Steven finds himself trapped in an increasingly unsettling world of constant surveillance, mounting suspicion, and unexplained instincts that suggest someone is controlling far more than his recovery.

releases.title: Primetime
releases.synopsis: Inspired by true events in 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice in this candy-colored thriller from Lance Oppenheim.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.synopsis: Bryan, a medical courier, is in the process of making a delivery when a sudden outbreak occurs, forcing him to fight for survival.

releases.title: Sense And Sensibility
releases.synopsis: Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate and move in with a distant relative, facing romance and money troubles.

releases.title: Without Blood
releases.synopsis: Written, directed, and produced by Angelina Jolie, Without Blood is based on the acclaimed international bestselling novel by renowned Italian writer Alessandro Baricco. An unforgettable saga set in the aftermath of an unidentified conflict, it explores universal truths about war, trauma, memory, and healing.

releases.title: A Dogs Perfect Christmas
releases.synopsis: From the bestselling author of A Dog’s Purpose, a tale of a family in crisis where a teenager, her grandfather, and his trusty basset hound struggle to keep the household together at Christmas.

releases.title: Super Troopers 3
releases.synopsis: Everyone’s favorite cops are back with the third installment of the cult comedy classic from the Broken Lizard crew: Super Troopers 3. When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

releases.title: Angel And The Badman
releases.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher’s daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he’ll become.

releases.title: Carolina Caroline
releases.synopsis: A young woman skips her small town — in search of her estranged mother — alongside a charismatic con man on the run from the law. The duo leave a wave of crime and passion behind them as they hustle their way through the Southeast.

releases.title: Leviticus
releases.synopsis: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

releases.title: Making Marie Antoinette
releases.synopsis: Eleanor Coppola’s behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

releases.title: Motor City
releases.synopsis: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls in love with the girlfriend of a local gangster. To get revenge, the gangster sets up a frame-up to send the innocent man to prison. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girlfriend away from him.

releases.title: Musk
releases.synopsis: A definitive and unvarnished examination of multi-billionaire tech entrepreneur Elon Musk.

releases.title: Possible Love
releases.synopsis: A story of two married couples — a laid-off worker and his spouse, and a documentary filmmaker and her spouse — crossing paths to film a documentary and facing their different lives and hidden desires.

releases.title: The Uprising
releases.synopsis: Andrew Garfield stars as the legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice and survival.

releases.title: Gail Daughtry And The Celebrity Sex Pass
releases.synopsis: A Midwestern bride-to-be, Gail Daughtry, has a celebrity hall pass agreement with her fiancé… who uses it. Their relationship in crisis, Gail sets out on an epic journey through Hollywood to even the scales.

releases.title: Misty Green
releases.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

releases.title: American Doctor
releases.synopsis: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

releases.title: Crawlers
releases.synopsis: When a deadly breed of flesh-eating arachnids is unleashed inside an apartment building, the tenants are quarantined. To survive the venomous onslaught, they must rely on Serena-their underappreciated building manager. She is the residents’ only hope for survival, but first, she must conquer her own deepest fears before the government takes drastic, lethal action.

releases.title: Falling
releases.synopsis: Johnny never expected to fall for Jillian-the enchanting girlfriend of his best friend, Jack. But as their forbidden attraction ignites, Johnny must choose between his first real love and the friendship that means everything.

releases.title: Ha Chan Shake Your Booty
releases.synopsis: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

releases.title: Heart Of The Beast
releases.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

releases.title: The Incomer
releases.synopsis: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

releases.title: Other Mommy
releases.synopsis: A young girl, her family and their home are haunted by a sinister entity that is determined to take up residence inside her. But first, it needs to persuade her to let it in…

releases.title: Guillermo Del Toros Pans Labyrinth 20Th Anniversary
releases.synopsis: In the definitive, true 4K restoration of Guillermo del Toro’s visionary, Academy Award-winning masterpiece, during the Spanish Civil War, a young girl, Ofelia (Ivana Baquero), escapes into a haunting fantasy world of magical and terrifying creatures. When a mythical faun (Doug Jones) reveals that she is a lost princess, Ofelia embarks on a dangerous quest to regain her throne. As she navigates the magical trials, the line between innocence and the brutality of war blurs.

releases.title: Avedon
releases.synopsis: From world leaders to pop culture icons and international supermodels, Richard Avedon’s influence helped create the blueprint for our image-driven world. His photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it. Avedon traces the life and legacy of an artist who used photography to reinvent the world around him. Drawing on unprecedented access to his personal archives — never-before-seen stills, intimate behind-the-lens footage, and new interviews with his closest collaborators — the film explores how his singular eye both reflected and reshaped the visual language of the 20th century and why even the most iconic image is only half the story.

releases.title: Tyler Perrys The Gospel Of Christmas
releases.synopsis: In Tyler Perry’s The Gospel of Christmas, a struggling pastor inherits his family’s church in a broken New York neighborhood, but as he battles doubt, temptation, and a sinister adversary, he must rediscover his faith and the power of prayer to save his church, his family, and his community.

releases.title: Paw Patrol The Dino Movie
releases.synopsis: The PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs after their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the Patrol’s archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they’ve done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

releases.title: Avengers Endgame Encore
releases.synopsis: Adrift in space with no food or water, Tony Stark sends a message to Pepper Potts as his oxygen supply starts to dwindle. Meanwhile, the remaining Avengers — Thor, Black Widow, Captain America and Bruce Banner — must figure out a way to bring back their vanquished allies for an epic showdown with Thanos — the evil demigod who decimated the planet and the universe.

releases.title: Being Heumann
releases.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

releases.title: The End Of Oak Street
releases.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

releases.title: Heartland
releases.synopsis: Former country megastar Misty Jones (Jessica Chastain) comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician, and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

releases.title: Appofeniacs
releases.synopsis: The use of AI technology reaches its most violent and bloody conclusion after a series of deepfake videos are unleashed into the world.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.synopsis: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

releases.title: Manhood
releases.synopsis: “Manhood” follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, “Manhood” examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

releases.title: The Odyssey
releases.synopsis: Odysseus, the legendary Greek king of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War, chronicling his encounters with mythical beings such as the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens, and the witch-goddess Circe, while attempting to reunite with his wife, Penelope.

releases.title: A Talent For Murder
releases.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

releases.title: Gentle Monster
releases.synopsis: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

releases.title: Guarding Stars
releases.synopsis: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

releases.title: Madden
releases.synopsis: John Madden’s remarkable journey-from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with Al Davis and the Raiders, to creating Madden NFL, and becoming one of the most iconic voices in football history.

releases.title: Best Pancakes In The County
releases.synopsis: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own. As loyalties blur and tensions erupt, survival depends on who can outthink – and outgun – everyone else. In this diner, the ‘best pancakes in the county’ turn out to be the least explosive thing on the menu.

releases.title: Ice Cream Man
releases.synopsis: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

releases.title: The Last Temptation Of Becky
releases.synopsis: Now a CIA field agent, Becky goes undercover in Poland to infiltrate a family running an inn at The Wolf’s Lair, one of Hitler’s WWII bunkers. When she learns the father, Wilhelm Reuss, plans to spark the Fourth Reich, Becky must stop him.

releases.title: Steps
releases.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella’s “evil” stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith (Ali Wong) is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot (Stephanie Hsu) into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella (and a surprisingly dreamy troll) to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

releases.title: Tony
releases.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

releases.title: Unbearable Christmas
releases.synopsis: Three days before Christmas, out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton drags his family on a cross-country mission to recover a priceless heirloom, sparking chaos, emotional blowups, and unexpected holiday magic.

releases.title: You Had To Be There How The Toronto Godspell Ignited The Comedy Revolution Spread Love Overalls And Created A Community That Changed The World In A Canadian Kind Of Way
releases.synopsis: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.

releases.title: Insidious Out Of The Further
releases.synopsis: A trio of stalkers infiltrate a quiet suburb and force a new family into the astral plane, where they uncover a terrifying truth: the Further is bleeding into the real world.

releases.title: Clashing Through The Snow
releases.synopsis: In this romantic comedy, a holiday snowstorm strands rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell (Chris Briney) and Hannah Hendricks (Michelle Randolph) at the airport, forcing them into a shared rental car for a cross-country race to New York. With budget cuts threatening to eliminate one of their jobs, both are secretly chasing a career-saving deal, turning every mile into a high-stakes showdown. But between roadside mishaps, unexpected detours and small-town charm, the holiday spirit has a way of melting even the fiercest rivalry into something neither of them saw coming.

releases.title: Fjord
releases.synopsis: After the deaths of Mihai’s parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave everything behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth’s family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius’ young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

releases.title: The Samurai And The Prisoner
releases.synopsis: Based on Honobu Yonezawa’s novel. Set in 16th century Japan, follows Lord Murashige Araki who, besieged in his castle, confronts mysterious crimes and allies with imprisoned strategist Kanbei Kuroda to uncover the truth.

releases.title: The Social Reckoning
releases.synopsis: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

releases.title: Wicker
releases.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

releases.title: The Mosquito Bowl
releases.synopsis: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor, four of America’s top college football stars set their fame aside to enlist in the Marines. As they prepare for the brutal invasion of Okinawa, they’ll play in a legendary game featuring some of the greatest players in history — a game that, for many, will be the last they ever play.

releases.title: Way Of The Warrior Kid
releases.synopsis: Young student Marc struggles with self-doubt…and a tough-talking bully. But things take a powerful turn when his uncle—an elite Navy SEAL—moves in for the summer and helps Marc find his inner fighter.

releases.title: Couture
releases.synopsis: Academy Award winner Angelina Jolie stars as an American filmmaker in Paris during Fashion Week, whose encounters with women from all walks of life spark a personal journey of self-discovery and force her to confront the choices shaping her life.

releases.title: The Holy Boy
releases.synopsis: In Italy’s happiest village, a haunted teacher discovers dark secret behind weekly gatherings where locals seek healing from a teenage boy’s embrace. His quest to save the youth reveals the sinister nature of a community hiding behind joy.

releases.title: Maddies Secret
releases.synopsis: Maddie is a plucky dishwasher who leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

releases.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
releases.synopsis: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They’re transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

releases.title: Runner
releases.synopsis: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

releases.title: Street Fighter
releases.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

releases.title: La Bola Negra
releases.synopsis: Set across three timelines — Republican Spain in 1932, the Civil War in 1937, and contemporary Spain in 2017 — the film follows a constellation of interconnected lives centered on three young men, whose emotional and political echoes gradually reveal themselves.

releases.title: In A Holidaze
releases.synopsis: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, a directionless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

releases.title: The Man With The Bag
releases.synopsis: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

releases.title: 14Th
releases.synopsis: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

releases.title: Dreamquil
releases.synopsis: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

releases.title: One Night Only
releases.synopsis: Two strangers scramble to find someone to sleep with on the one night of the year when premarital sex is legal.

releases.title: Unholy Night
releases.synopsis: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree. As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

releases.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
releases.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

releases.title: Bad Day
releases.synopsis: A single mom fights to keep one little promise to her daughter on the absolute worst day of her life.

releases.title: In Waves
releases.synopsis: In Los Angeles, AJ, a shy teenager, meets Kristen. She lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

releases.title: Jean Michel Basquiat
releases.synopsis: Jean-Michel Basquiat is a reclamation of what has been lost in the legacy of a globally renowned artist. Through untold memories from close friends and family, never-before-seen works, and rare archival imagery, this film demystifies the story of Basquiat and discovers the man behind it all, Jean-Michel.

releases.title: Batman Knightfall Part 2 Knightquest
releases.synopsis: Arkham Asylum’s destruction releases Gotham’s most dangerous criminals onto the streets. Batman must recapture them while being pushed to his breaking point, leading to an ultimate showdown with the formidable Bane.

releases.title: Killing Castro
releases.synopsis: In 1960, Fidel Castro came to America to speak at the UN shortly after winning the Cuban Revolution. Having been turned away by all of the hotels in Manhattan, he is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA, and the Mafia attempt to eliminate him -by any means necessary.

releases.title: Ray Gunn
releases.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder, and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

releases.title: The Sun Never Sets
releases.synopsis: AWendy (Fanning) finds her life upended when her boyfriend Jack (Johnson)—older, divorced, and with children—asks for space to reassess their relationship. During their separation, Wendy reconnects with her ex, Chuck (Smith), sparking an emotionally charged love triangle that forces all three to confront the realities of love, timing, and personal growth.

releases.title: The Adventures Of Cliff Booth
releases.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood, Cliff Booth navigates the studio system in his new role as a fixer.

theatrical.title: La Bola Negra
theatrical.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

theatrical.title: Fatherland
theatrical.synopsis: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

theatrical.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
theatrical.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

theatrical.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
theatrical.synopsis: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

theatrical.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
theatrical.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

theatrical.title: Scene
theatrical.synopsis: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

theatrical.title: On Behalf of My Son
theatrical.synopsis: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

theatrical.title: Wild Horse Nine
theatrical.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

theatrical.title: The Cat in the Hat
theatrical.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

theatrical.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
theatrical.synopsis: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

theatrical.title: Drummer Boy
theatrical.synopsis: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

theatrical.title: Jimmy
theatrical.synopsis: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

theatrical.title: I Play Rocky
theatrical.synopsis: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

theatrical.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
theatrical.synopsis: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

theatrical.title: Mouse
theatrical.synopsis: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

theatrical.title: Club Kid
theatrical.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

theatrical.title: Disco
theatrical.synopsis: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

theatrical.title: Avedon
theatrical.synopsis: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

theatrical.title: Daffy Season
theatrical.synopsis: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

theatrical.title: Raise the Red Lantern
theatrical.synopsis: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

theatrical.title: Being Heumann
theatrical.synopsis: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

theatrical.title: Everytime
theatrical.synopsis: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap.

theatrical.title: Hen
theatrical.synopsis: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

theatrical.title: The Liberation
theatrical.synopsis: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

theatrical.title: Paradise Lost
theatrical.synopsis: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

theatrical.title: Ghost Soldier
theatrical.synopsis: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

theatrical.title: Confession
theatrical.synopsis: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

theatrical.title: DNK
theatrical.synopsis: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

theatrical.title: Itllu Arjuna
theatrical.synopsis: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

theatrical.title: Ebenezer
theatrical.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

theatrical.title: How to Rob a Bank
theatrical.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

theatrical.title: Victorian Psycho
theatrical.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

theatrical.title: Paper Tiger
theatrical.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

theatrical.title: Bitter Christmas
theatrical.synopsis: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

theatrical.title: Traces of Justice
theatrical.synopsis: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

theatrical.title: God with Us
theatrical.synopsis: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

theatrical.title: Madden
theatrical.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

theatrical.title: ENE Repeat
theatrical.synopsis: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

theatrical.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
theatrical.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

theatrical.title: Minotaur
theatrical.synopsis: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

theatrical.title: Elsinore
theatrical.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

theatrical.title: Josephine
theatrical.synopsis: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

theatrical.title: November 1963
theatrical.synopsis: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

theatrical.title: The Vile
theatrical.synopsis: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

theatrical.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
theatrical.synopsis: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

theatrical.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
theatrical.synopsis: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

theatrical.title: Focker-in-Law
theatrical.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

theatrical.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
theatrical.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

theatrical.title: All of a Sudden
theatrical.synopsis: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

theatrical.title: Hershey
theatrical.synopsis: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

theatrical.title: Lilo & Scratch
theatrical.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

theatrical.title: Tangles
theatrical.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

theatrical.title: In Waves
theatrical.synopsis: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

theatrical.title: UK Holiday
theatrical.synopsis: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

theatrical.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
theatrical.synopsis: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

theatrical.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
theatrical.synopsis: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

theatrical.title: Ray Gunn
theatrical.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

theatrical.title: Violent Night 2
theatrical.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

theatrical.title: Behemoth!
theatrical.synopsis: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

theatrical.title: Flavia
theatrical.synopsis: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

theatrical.title: The Gallerist
theatrical.synopsis: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

theatrical.title: The Fox
theatrical.synopsis: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

theatrical.title: Above the Below
theatrical.synopsis: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

theatrical.title: Tender Loving Care
theatrical.synopsis: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

theatrical.title: A Long Winter
theatrical.synopsis: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

theatrical.title: Eternal Return
theatrical.synopsis: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

theatrical.title: The Friend's House is Here
theatrical.synopsis: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

theatrical.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
theatrical.synopsis: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

theatrical.title: Alias Rukmini
theatrical.synopsis: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

theatrical.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
theatrical.synopsis: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

theatrical.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
theatrical.synopsis: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

theatrical.title: The Test
theatrical.synopsis: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

theatrical.title: The Debut
theatrical.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

theatrical.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
theatrical.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

theatrical.title: Rose
theatrical.synopsis: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

theatrical.title: Ink
theatrical.synopsis: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

theatrical.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
theatrical.synopsis: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

theatrical.title: Bunker
theatrical.synopsis: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

theatrical.title: Killing Castro
theatrical.synopsis: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

theatrical.title: Clarissa
theatrical.synopsis: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

theatrical.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
theatrical.synopsis: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

theatrical.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
theatrical.synopsis: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

theatrical.title: Straight Circle
theatrical.synopsis: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

theatrical.title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
theatrical.synopsis: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

theatrical.title: Samo Lives
theatrical.synopsis: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

theatrical.title: Summer School, 2001
theatrical.synopsis: A teenage boy returns to his family after years apart, scarred from being sent to Vietnam while his younger brother stayed in Czechia. After reunion, he faces a distant father, a mother desperate to mend the past, and a brother uneasy about sharing the spotlight. One chaotic summer pushes them to their limits when the younger brother falls from a roof. Between misunderstandings and clumsy family dynamics, they learn that sometimes, healing begins by letting the cracks show.

theatrical.title: American Baby
theatrical.synopsis: Oli becomes an outcast in her community when she gets pregnant at 15. As she seeks out the suddenly absent teenage father-to-be, Oli confronts the growing isolation from her community.

theatrical.title: Starlight
theatrical.synopsis: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

theatrical.title: To Hold a Mountain
theatrical.synopsis: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

theatrical.title: Avengers: Doomsday
theatrical.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

theatrical.title: Dune: Part Three
theatrical.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

theatrical.title: La Gradiva
theatrical.synopsis: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

theatrical.title: The Day She Returns
theatrical.synopsis: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

theatrical.title: The Raven of Baltimore City
theatrical.synopsis: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

theatrical.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
theatrical.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

theatrical.title: King
theatrical.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

theatrical.title: Dada
theatrical.synopsis: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

theatrical.title: Jumanji: Open World
theatrical.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

theatrical.title: Coward
theatrical.synopsis: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

theatrical.title: Werwulf
theatrical.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

theatrical.title: Artificial
theatrical.synopsis: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

theatrical.title: Mr. Irrelevant
theatrical.synopsis: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

theatrical.title: The Poolrooms
theatrical.synopsis: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

theatrical.title: wyrdo
theatrical.synopsis: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

theatrical.title: Look Back
theatrical.synopsis: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

theatrical.title: Apophis 2029
theatrical.synopsis: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.
